question: By which name is the birthday of Lord Krishna famous?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Janmashtami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Janmashtami**

 
 
• **​T**he birthday o**f Lord Krishna** famous is famous by the name of **Janmashtami**.
 
• **Krishna Janmashtami**, which translates to **"Occasion of the birth of Krishna,"** is a **Hindu festival** that honours the birth of **Krishna**, the **eighth **manifestation of **Vishnu**.
 
• It is also known as **Krishnashtami**, **Janmashtami**, or **Gokulashtami**. **Ashtami**, the eighth tithi of the **Krishna Paksha **(dark fortnight) of **Shraavana Masa** (according to amanta tradition) or **Bhadrapada Masa**, is the day on which it is observed in accordance with the **Hindu **lunisolar calendar (according to the purnimanta tradition).
 
• This falls during the **Gregorian calendar **months of **August** or **September**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Particularly in the Hindu **Vaishnavism **tradition, it is a significant **festival**.
 
• The celebrations of **Janmashtami **include **fasting **(upavasa), a **night vigil** (Ratri Jagaran), devotional **singing** through the midnight when **Krishna **was **born**,** dance-drama** reenactments of Krishna's life as described in the **Bhagavata Purana**.
